## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid youth with a round, expressionless face. He is twenty years old and exhibits a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a large, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face and a notable lack of conversational skills. He is also characterized as a jealous individual who makes his wife's life miserable.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P46](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0046)_

## History

Billy Andrews drove [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane home from a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), during which the girls discussed the wealthy guests they had met. Later, after his father granted him the upper farm in his own name, Billy sought to marry [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Being shy, he had his sister Jane propose to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on his behalf, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined the offer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), +59 more_

## Relationships

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane.md)

Jane is Billy's sister. Due to Billy's extreme shyness, Jane acts as his messenger, even proposing marriage to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) on his behalf during an overnight visit. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) turns down the proposal, Jane calmly accepts the refusal and suggests that Billy will likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P8](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0008)</sub>

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) is Billy's sister, and he often provides transportation for her and her friends, such as driving Jane, [Anne](../character/anne.md), and [Diana](../character/diana.md) home from a concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). Because Billy is too bashful to speak for himself, Jane handles his personal matters, including delivering a marriage proposal to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on his behalf. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejects the offer, Jane accepts the outcome placidly and notes his alternative marriage prospects.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Proposal P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013)</sub>

### [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

[Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) is the woman Billy is expected to marry following his rejected proposal to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). When [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on Billy's behalf and is turned down, Jane casually remarks that Billy will likely marry Nettie instead.

- Spouse of — married (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
